'''1998 Bespin Regional (Minneapolis)''' was a Star Wars CCG regional held in Minneapolis, Minnesota on 22 August 1998. [[Adam Ankrum]] won it. It is known from Jim Li's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1275">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-27-old-bespin-regional-98d1275/ old-bespin-regional-98], DeckTech (Jim "Stimmed Jim" Li, 27 September 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-27-old-bespin-regional-98d1275/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 22 August 1998
* '''Site:''' Minneapolis, Minnesota
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace]]
* '''Players:''' 90
* '''Winner:''' [[Adam Ankrum]]
